experiment_data.hypothesis: Uniform weighting with epoch-matched training tokens (max_steps=2533) and independent linear LR schedule (5e-5, full decay over 2533 steps) serves as the controlled baseline for LR confound elimination. Paired with dr_epoch_matched_indep_lr_seed42 (PPL=18.78) to quantify pure epoch-matching effect without LR schedule artifacts.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/provenance_weight_training && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 WANDB_MODE=disabled python -u training/pretrain_weighted.py --data_path data/scored_data.jsonl --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/uniform_epoch_matched_indep_lr_seed42 --model_name models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --weighting_method uniform --contamination_ratio 0.4 --max_steps 2533 --batch_size 4 --gradient_accumulation_steps 4 --learning_rate 5e-5 --max_length 2048 --seed 42 --save_steps 500 --logging_steps 10 --bf16 --save_total_limit 3"
